user.title: Connect to OVO Energy Australia
user.description:
Sign in with your OVO Energy Australia account to track energy usage, costs, solar generation, and connected vehicles.

Your energy plan and rates are automatically detected from OVO's API. No manual plan selection or rate entry required.

**Privacy & Security:**
• Credentials are stored in Home Assistant's configuration storage
• They are used only to access your data through OVO's services
• Short-lived access tokens are refreshed first
• Your password is used again only if OVO rejects the refresh token
• Credentials are never shared with third parties or external services

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with OVO Energy
reauth_confirm.description:
Your OVO Energy session has expired. Please sign in again to restore monitoring. Refresh tokens are always tried before this password fallback.

Enter your OVO Energy credentials below:

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to OVO Energy API. Please check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Please verify your email address and password are correct.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again or check Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This OVO Energy account is already configured in Home Assistant.
abort.reauth_successful: Re-authentication successful! Your energy sensors will resume updating.
abort.reauth_account_mismatch: These credentials belong to a different OVO account. Sign in with the account this integration was set up with, or remove and re-add the integration.
abort.reauth_failed: Re-authentication failed: the original configuration entry could not be found. Please remove and re-add the integration.

init.title: OVO Energy Settings
init.description:
Configure device grouping, billing cycle, and optional distributor peak schedules. Plan and tariff rates are automatically detected from OVO's API unless manual override is selected.

**Billing cycle:** Set to the day your billing cycle begins (1-31). Leave at 1 to follow calendar months or auto-detect from your latest bill.

**Peak schedule:** Free and EV windows are automatic. Set peak start and end hours only if your network distributor uses Time-of-Use peak boundaries not reported by OVO.

data.manual_override: Advanced: Manually override plan and tariff rates

manual_rates.title: Manual Plan & Tariff Overrides
manual_rates.description: Manually specify your energy plan and tariff rates. These will override the values automatically detected from OVO's API.
